pr_body:
Fixes #6540

This PR adds `gh ext search`, the scriptable and screen-readable companion command to `gh ext browse`.

It's pretty straightforward and just wraps `searcher.Search`, suggesting to use `gh search repos` for more fine grained interaction.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/98482/200083552-da39a2ed-cb6c-4ebb-8e94-6309f9638196.png)

issue_context.title: gh ext search
issue_context.body:
As a scriptable and more screen reader friendly alternative to the upcoming `gh ext browse`, let's add `gh ext search` as another way of discovering extensions.

Under the hood, this command should execute a `Searcher` query using any positional arguments.

The output should have columns for:

- full repo name
- installed or not
- official or not
